market_summary: Late New York session trading shows indices and crypto holding bullish structures above VWAP/EMA50 while precious metals and major FX pairs remain in strong down-trends below VWAP. However, multiple instruments are currently consolidating near extreme boundaries (Session Lows/Highs, GEX Gamma Flips/Call Walls) with neutral/fading volume and CVD momentum, favoring a HOLD stance across the board to await fresh structural triggers.

signals.rationale: Price is below VAL (4018.13) and below POC (4044.14). CVD is BEARISH (-3.30) aligning with selling pressure. SESSION is NEW_YORK_SESSION. Price is strongly below VWAP (4032.78) and EMA50 (4017.56), touching the lower ATR band (3988.11). Volume lacks RVOL spikes recently. GEX regime is NEGATIVE_AMPLIFYING below Gamma Flip (3992.82) with Put Wall #1 breached at 4013.21. Session Low (3982.90) is currently being tested. Extended downside move near session low makes fresh shorting risky, suggesting a temporary pause.
signals.level_event: rejection of Gamma Flip and Put Wall #1

signals.rationale: Price is inside the Value Area (VAL 1.10824 to VAH 1.11455) and below POC (1.10920). CVD is BEARISH (-15,734) with negative slope (-783.85), agreeing with the downtrend. SESSION is NEW_YORK_SESSION. Price is well below VWAP (1.11236) and EMA50 (1.11123), hovering near the EMA20 baseline and mid-channel. RVOL is low (0.662). Price is consolidating near Session Low support (1.10824) without dynamic volume expansion or structural signal bar breakout.

Price is inside Value Area (VAL 1.32661 to VAH 1.33233) and below POC (1.32813). CVD is NEUTRAL (-1,768) with positive short-term slope (+235.94), showing CVD divergence vs the overarching downtrend. SESSION is NEW_YORK_SESSION. Price trades below VWAP (1.33057) and EMA50 (1.32959). Volume is quiet with RVOL 0.382. Price is consolidating right near Session Low (1.32661) inside a tight channel without momentum confirmation.

Price is above VAH (28343.60) and POC (28267.73). CVD is BULLISH (+12.01), though cvd_slope is slightly negative (-1.95). SESSION is NEW_YORK_SESSION. Price is above VWAP (28220.30) and EMA50 (28333.74). Per US100 tick volume rules, low RVOL (0.855) is expected. GEX regime is NEGATIVE_AMPLIFYING; price is sitting right at the Gamma Flip (28469.31) and under Call Wall #1 (28548.60). Buying directly under Call Wall #1 and immediately at Gamma Flip presents poor risk location.
signals.level_event: rejection near Call Wall #1 / Gamma Flip

signals.rationale: Price is above VAH (73998.28) and POC (73660.42). CVD is BEARISH (-0.07) flat, showing delta divergence against the price uptrend. SESSION is NEW_YORK_SESSION. Price is above VWAP (73807.13) and EMA50 (74001.87), consolidating below Session High (74706.20) after pulling back from the upper ATR band (74721.42). Volume confirmation is lacking with zero RVOL spikes. Lack of volume backing and CVD divergence warrants holding.
signals.level_event: rejection off upper ATR band / Session High
